 CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR
For the Petitioner : Mr. Anish Kumar Mishra, Adv.
Heard learned counsel for the revisionist.

2. The instant criminal revision has been filed for setting aside the order dated 06.07.2024 passed by the learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Garhwa in Original Maintenance Case No.06 of 2020,
whereby a meager amount of Rs.4,000/- per month has been awarded as maintenance.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the husband had filed a petition for restitution of conjugal rights and further a divorce petition has also been filed due to non-presumption of conjugal rights.
It has been further submitted that the petitioner is a daily wager and the maintenance amount is on the higher side.
4. Having heard learned counsel for the revisionist and from perusal of the record, it appears that there is an allegation of cruelty and as such allegation of Section 498A of IPC has also been made.
The family court has considered the entire materials brought on record and has recorded the finding that the wife has reasonable reason for not residing with the husband.
After considering the income which has been brought on record, a meager amount of Rs.4,000/- per month has been awarded as maintenance.
